taxes.tax: Per-worker fees on employers (work permits of foreign workers)
unsupported: 3000 taxes on payroll and workforce: work-permit fees for non-Egyptian workers (Labour Law 12/2003 and the ministerial fee decree under it; not read); no payroll tax in the laws read (Income Tax Law 91/2005, Social Insurance Law 148/2019, VAT Law 67/2016). Coordinator decision of pass 3l: OECD 3000 covers taxes paid by employers as a fixed amount per person employed, so a per-worker fee levied by law on employers belongs here and the heading is not cited absent until the fee text is read; a one-off permit issuance charge that does not scale with the workforce is not a tax (note only). No company input carries the workforce by nationality. Grade C (pass 3l).

notLevied.why: 4200: no net wealth tax: Constitution of the Arab Republic of Egypt (2014, as amended 2019) art. 38: public taxes cannot be established, modified or cancelled except by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Egypt_2019.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Income Tax Law 91/2005, VAT Law 67/2016, Social Insurance Law 148/2019. convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).

4300: no inheritance, estate or gift tax: Constitution of the Arab Republic of Egypt (2014, as amended 2019) art. 38: public taxes cannot be established, modified or cancelled except by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Egypt_2019.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Income Tax Law 91/2005, VAT Law 67/2016, Social Insurance Law 148/2019. convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).

6000: no zakat or other tax outside the taxes listed: Constitution of the Arab Republic of Egypt (2014, as amended 2019) art. 38: public taxes cannot be established, modified or cancelled except by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Egypt_2019.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Income Tax Law 91/2005, VAT Law 67/2016, Social Insurance Law 148/2019. convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).
